# Best noise-cancelling headphones under $200

Prices move often, so check the current price before you buy.

| Pick | Best for | Approx. price |
|---|---|---|
| **JBL Live 780NC** | Strongest noise cancelling | Sometimes just under $200 on sale |
| **Soundcore Space One Pro** | Comfort and an all-around pick | $199.99 ($160 with code) |
| **Soundcore Space One** | Best value | $99.99 ($80 with code) |
| **Sennheiser Accentum Plus** | Sound quality | Under $200 (varies by retailer) |
| **Sony ULT WEAR** | Calls and overall performance | About $200 |
| **JLab JBuds Lux ANC** | Cheapest way to try ANC | About $80 |

## Top picks

**Best noise cancelling: JBL Live 780NC.** RTINGS ranks it #1 under $200. Its ANC rivals flagship Sony and Bose models, and it lasts 60 hours per charge. The downsides are high clamping force and thin headband padding, which may bother people with larger heads. RTINGS notes it sometimes drops just below the $200 cutoff. [RTINGS review and price links](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/noise-cancelling-headphones-under-200)

**Best value: Soundcore Space One ($99.99).** SoundGuys measured about 43 hours of battery with ANC on. It supports LDAC, which only helps if your phone does too, so Android owners benefit most. [Buy at Soundcore](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-space-one)

**Most comfortable: Soundcore Space One Pro ($199.99).** Tom's Guide names it best under $200 and highlights its soft ear cups. [Buy at Soundcore](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-space-one-pro)

**Best sound: Sennheiser Accentum Plus.** RTINGS found a warm, bassy tuning with a parametric EQ and about 56 hours of battery. Its ANC is weaker than the JBL's, especially against low rumble like plane engines. [RTINGS review](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/noise-cancelling-headphones-under-200)

**Best for calls and all-round use: Sony ULT WEAR.** It has strong ANC, multipoint, and LDAC. SoundGuys measured over 25 dB of attenuation above 80 Hz. It sits right at $200, so it may land slightly over budget. [Overview](https://ratingmobile.com/articles/en/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-200)

**Cheapest option: JLab JBuds Lux ANC (~$80).** It has a long battery life and good sound for the price. Its ANC is the weakest of the group (10–20 dB under 700 Hz), so it takes the edge off a bus or office rather than silencing a flight. [Tom's Guide list](https://www.tomsguide.com/us/best-noise-cancelling-headphones%2Creview-5566.html)

## Also worth a look
- **Anker Soundcore Space Q45 (~$100).** RTINGS calls it the best headphones under $200 overall, with excellent ANC and about 28 hours of battery. Some owners report headband and hinge breakage. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/by-price/under-200)
- **Sony WH-CH730N ($176–178).** It has great sound and ANC, but Tom's Guide thinks the US price is too high. [Review](https://www.tomsguide.com/audio/headphones/sony-wh-ch730n-review)
